claims.public_claim: ChatGPT has more than 900 million weekly active users.
claims.time_window: weekly active users as disclosed on 2026-02-27
claims.method: OpenAI company disclosure; no underlying measurement method is provided on the page
claims.scope_and_limitations: The statistic establishes product reach, not local service-search intent, recommendation likelihood, rankings, leads, or revenue.
claims.privacy_treatment: none required for a public aggregate
claims.allowed_public_wording: More than 900 million people use ChatGPT each week. When one asks for an MSP in your area, is your firm part of the measured answer?
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not infer local purchase intent, model recommendation, first position, leads, or revenue from global weekly usage.
